maya (research): Heads-up — I prototyped a packaging schema for quant profiles that Optimize will consume. Want input on consumer-facing names and rollout hooks before I commit.

anna (ml): Can you paste the schema? quick thumbs.

maya (research): Sure — rough YAML sketch: 
```
qprofile:
  id: "uuid-..."
  format_version: "1"
  model: "mosaicml/mpt-7b"
  backend: "awq-v0.2"   # options: gptq, awq, fp8-int8
  bitwidth: "8"
  perf_tier: "latency-optimized"   # latency / cost / quality
  accuracy_delta: -0.6  # percent vs FP32 baseline
  rollout: { canary: true, traffic: "5%" }
  consumer_name: "mpt7_awq_8_lat_v1"
```

josh (platform): One ask: consumer_name should be stable and human-friendly and safe for URLs/filenames. Suggest dash-separated tokens, shorter model shortname, no underscores. Eg: `mpt7-awq8-lat-v1`.

li (eng): Also add a `compat` field listing compatible runtime versions and supported kv-cache formats. We hit subtle regressions when runtime changed but qprofiles didn't declare compat.

sam (prodeng): From ProdEng POV, rollout hooks need automated health checks + an automatic rollback window. Recommend explicit fields: `canary_duration`, `metrics` array (e.g., `p50_latency`, `p99_latency`, `token_error_rate`), and a `rollback_on` clause.

opt-bot: profile validator: local validation passed; accuracy_delta (-0.6%) within Optimize threshold (<= -1.0%).

maya (research): Agree. Plan: bump `format_version` to `2` to include `compat`, `aliases`, and expanded `rollout` with `canary_duration` + `rollback_on`. Proposal for `consumer_name` convention: `{model_short}-{backend}{bit}-{tier}-v{semver}`. Example: `mpt7-awq8-lat-v1` or `gptj-gptq8-qual-v2`. Thoughts on semver vs monotonically increasing int?

anna (ml): Semver is useful: MAJOR when we change quant backend semantics (e.g., different kernel layout), MINOR for non-breaking perf or metadata changes. Patch for tiny tweaks.

li (eng): :thumbsup: Add `aliases` array so Optimize can map legacy names during migration (e.g., `mpt7_awq_8_lat_v1` -> new canonical). Also include `hashes` for reproducibility (artifact id + model checksum).

sam (prodeng): And include a `slo_targets` section so rollouts can validate SLOs (latency p99 < X ms). We'll wire those into the canary pipeline.

maya (research): Great — I'll update the spec and open a PR with converters + a migration script that maps legacy qpkg names to `consumer_name` and populates `aliases`. TL;DR for PR: consumer_name pattern, `compat`, `aliases`, rollout hooks (canary + auto-rollback), `slo_targets`, and `hashes`. Anyone want to review the PR when it's up? tagging @anna @li @josh.

anna (ml): I'll review tomorrow morning.

josh (platform): I'll add console UX copy so names don't confuse end users — maybe surface a friendly label + tooltip that maps to `consumer_name`.

li (eng): I'll double-check runtime compat matrix and add a CI gate to reject qprofiles that declare incompatible runtime versions.

maya (research): Thanks — I'll aim to open the PR by EOD PST. If anyone wants a quick sync call, ping me.
